batch: Architecture Batch 4 - Oracle-Guided Selective Reconstruction on Diffuse-Interaction Native Lego (Mechanism 2 only)
declared: 2026-10-18, before any pilot render, oracle computation or model training of this batch
mechanism_scope: Mechanism 2 only: reconstruction of an externally given target set. No scene-level target selection (Mechanism 1) is implemented or evaluated; the dirty set is an oracle from ground-truth radiance.

scene.name: Diffuse Interaction Variant A
scene.object_A: the official RNA Lego (Lego_rough_aovs_normalized.blend): geometry, 8 materials and transform unchanged. Bright receivers: sand baseplate (diffuse 0.53/0.44/0.25), yellow body/bucket (SSS 0.80/0.50/0.03); all opaque materials = diffuse/SSS base + roughness-0.3 glossy coat
scene.object_B: axis-aligned box 0.20 x 0.15 x 0.25 m, bottom z = -0.186 (plate top under the footprint -0.198 at T0, -0.1897 at T1; 12 / 3.6 mm gap, no contact, no coincident faces), material = copy of the official 'Gray' node graph (diffuse + roughness-0.3 glossy, mix 0.05, same AOV outputs) with diffuse colour set to saturated red (linear 0.75, 0.03, 0.02)
scene.placement_rationale: free space under A's raised bucket (no A geometry between z -0.17 and 0.15 for y in [-0.80, -0.35]): B is surrounded by the sand plate (floor), the bucket underside (ceiling, >= 7 cm above B) and the body front (>= 0.15 m behind B), so its diffuse red reflection reaches bright persistent A surfaces; asymmetric (left of centre at T0, right at T1) so the two states affect distinguishable A regions
scene.T1: B centre (+0.22, -0.56, -0.061): rigid translation DELTA = (+0.44, 0, 0); materials identical between T0 and T1; A unchanged
scene.T1b: the whole T1 arrangement translated by -DELTA (A at -DELTA, B at its T0 place): B-frame view of T1 for B's correspondence. Valid because the only light is the generator's directional sun (world output Surface unlinked; upstream removes any Background node), so translating the whole arrangement leaves every radiance unchanged
scene.clearance_check: no Lego vertex within 2 mm of B at T0 or T1 (nearest 23 / 15 mm before the height correction, recorded in the worklog)
scene.not_tuned: position, size, colour, roughness and edit magnitude fixed here; never changed after pilot or model results. A limited alternative is allowed only if the pilot fails an explicit physical-validity criterion (P1-P5), with the reason documented.

render_contract.generator: upstream scripts/generate_dataset.py --mode rna (unchanged) via experiments/rna_reproduction/rr_run.py with RR_SEED (cameras: numpy, light dirs: torch)
render_contract.settings: upstream: 1024x1024 (oracle views 512x512), max bounces 32, sample_clamp_direct 20, sun energy 5.0, angle 0, light dirs on the upper hemisphere, cameras on the upper hemisphere r = 2.75 looking at the origin, FOV 45, visibility = diffuse_direct pass
render_contract.cycles_seed: set in the blend (scene.cycles.seed): 0 = the official value (training data); 1 and 2 = two independent noise realisations for references
render_contract.pairing: T0, T1 and T1b sets of one purpose share RR_SEED, so every view has the same camera and light in all variants (verified from the camera json and light_dir); same Cycles seed in T0 and T1 per realisation

datasets.train_T0_T1: 400 images, 1024 spp, 1024^2, per-pixel random light (upstream training mode), Cycles seed 0, RR_SEED 4701 (paired)
datasets.heldout_T0_T1: 16 views, one light per view (upstream validation mode), 1024^2, 2 x 2048 spp (Cycles seeds 1, 2), RR_SEED 4702. Reference = mean of the two realisations (4096 spp); inputs (AOVs, visibility) from realisation 1; noise = their difference
datasets.oracle_T0_T1_T1b: 32 views, validation mode, 512^2, 2 x 2048 spp (Cycles seeds 1, 2), RR_SEED 4703; never used for training or for arm evaluation
datasets.lightning_monitor: training-time val_psnr monitoring uses the held-out set of the same scene; it never selects weights (final weights are used everywhere)

ownership.A_units: L16 of worklog 36 unchanged (partition_L16.npz: k-means cells over the official mesh, same centres); unit of an A point = nearest L16 centre of its triangle-identified on-surface point (A centres only)
ownership.B_units: rule: K_B = max(1, round(16 * area_B / area_A)) = 1 (area_B 0.235 m^2, area_A 27.0 m^2): B is one unit (unit 16) with its own connected component (1872); PU never blends A and B
ownership.surface_identity: a rendered point is placed on a triangle of the combined mesh of the current state (Lego triangles + B's 12 triangles at the state's placement), with the worklog-36 LegoOwner rule (candidates from centroids and auxiliary points, exact distance, |n_t.n| >= 0.3)
ownership.canonical_frame: each object has a canonical frame = its T0 placement. Unit inputs use canonical positions: x_c = x_world - offset_object(state) (T0: 0; T1: B +DELTA; T1b: A -DELTA). Rigid translation only, so camera/light directions and normals are unchanged. The dataset AABB used for normalisation is the T0 training set's (equal to the T1 set's, checked)
ownership.unit_specs: A units: the worklog-36 matched specs exactly (texel-size triplane 125-196, MLP width 128 = 512/sqrt(16)); B unit: same texel rule on its canonical AABB (+2% margin), width 128
ownership.composition: worklog-34/36 PU, h = 4.5 mm, exact bisector distance, same-component only (b3_compose.LegoPUComposer unchanged)
ownership.isolation_note: the edit adapter (owner over the combined state mesh, canonical shift, B unit spec) lives in experiments/rna_selective_reconstruction_lego; no worklog-32/34/36 module or checkpoint is modified

oracle.semantics: a unit is transport-dirty (in D*) when the radiance its learned function must output changes between T0 and T1 by more than tau on its own corresponding surface. In RNA the direct sun term is selected at run time by the explicit visibility input, so on pixels whose visibility is unchanged the T0->T1 radiance change equals the indirect-radiance change (the direct term is local and identical); the oracle measures exactly that, on those pixels only
oracle.pixels: oracle views; for A units pairs (T0 view v, T1 view v), for B pairs (T0 view v, T1b view v); a pixel counts for unit i when alpha = 1 in both, the first-hit object is the same, the owner is unit i in both, the AOV positions agree within 1 mm (canonical frame), and the visibility flag is equal in both and in its 3x3 neighbourhood in both (removes shadow-edge pixels)
oracle.statistic: display space T(L) = (L/(1+L))^(1/2.2) per channel (the evaluation metric's transform). With d_k = T(L1,k) - T(L0,k) for realisations k = 1, 2, MS_i = mean over unit-i pixels and channels of d_1 * d_2 (unbiased for the squared change: the realisations are independent). RMS_i = sqrt(max(MS_i, 0)). 90% CI by bootstrap over views (2000 resamples, seed 0)
oracle.tau_justification: an RMS display error of 0.005 added independently to the qualified native RNA error (RMS 0.0213 at 33.44 dB, worklog 36 held-out) lowers a region's PSNR by 0.23 dB, below the measured spread between two equally valid native RNA models (0.26 dB, worklog 36). A smaller change is not distinguishable from model-to-model variation
oracle.rule: D* = { i : RMS_i > tau } (point estimate). Units with < 2000 counted pixels are 'under-observed' and are put in D* (validity not demonstrated). V* = the rest
oracle.reported_not_used: ambiguous units (90% CI contains tau); classification at tau/2 and 2 tau (sensitivity only); per-unit visibility-change fraction (direct-shadow regime change, handled by the explicit visibility input, D_vis diagnostic); per-unit local change: 99th percentile of 8x8-block RMS change (blocks >= 32 counted px), flagged 'locally changed but valid' when > 4 tau; per-channel mean change (colour bleeding); dirty-surface fraction (area and pixels); changed-region energy
oracle.cannot_detect: changes on surfaces never seen in the oracle views; changes only on pixels whose visibility differs (excluded by construction; reported as D_vis); changes below the noise of 32 views x 512^2 x 4096 spp (reported via CIs); angular changes at camera/light directions not sampled by 32 views

pilot_P_criteria.P1_indirect_change: pooled over stationary A counted pixels, the noise-debiased mean-square change has bootstrap z >= 4
pilot_P_criteria.P2_above_noise_and_tolerance: at least one stationary A unit has 90% CI lower bound of RMS_i > tau
pilot_P_criteria.P3_nonlocal_colour_bleeding: on stationary A counted pixels within 0.15 m of B's T1 box, mean linear (R - G) change > 0, and within 0.15 m of B's T0 box < 0, each with 90% bootstrap CI excluding 0
pilot_P_criteria.P4_identity: owner on-surface distance q99.9 <= 1.125 mm (worklog-36 test tolerance) in T0, T1 and T1b; among pixels whose first hit is A in both T0 and T1 (resp. B in T0 and T1b), >= 90% have the same unit and positions within 1 mm
pilot_P_criteria.stop: if any of P1-P5 fails, stop before training data generation and report

arms.SO_T0: 17 owned units, T0 training data, from initialisation, 250 epochs, seed 0, worklog-32 trainer (rso_train) unchanged: the T0 learned state
arms.A_full: T1 full recompute: all 17 units re-initialised and trained on T1 data, 250 epochs, seed 0
arms.B_selective: init = SO_T0 state; re-initialise every unit in D*, train only those (requires_grad False on V*, the worklog-36 REINIT mechanism) on T1 data, 250 epochs, seed 0
arms.C_frozen: SO_T0 state evaluated on T1 (canonical frames), no training
arms.RNA_T0_RNA_T1: original upstream RNA HQ (unchanged config, data on host), each scene, 250 epochs, seed 0, final weights: static representability controls, separately labelled
arms.composition: primary evaluation of owned arms under PU (the qualified composition); hard selection also reported

evaluation.sets: held-out T1 (all arms), held-out T0 (SO_T0, RNA_T0 qualification)
evaluation.metrics: worklog-36 metrics (view-mean/pooled PSNR, logL1, hf |e|, per-unit, per-material, seam J, band/off-band) + region errors (display MSE and |e|): D*-owned, V*-owned, PU band of D* units inside V* units, physically changed / unchanged / uncorresponded A pixels, B pixels
evaluation.pixel_regions: from the paired held-out T0/T1 references: A pixel corresponded as in the oracle (without the visibility condition); 'changed' if its 5x5 same-unit box-filtered |d| (mean of realisations) > max(2 tau, 4 sigma_box) with sigma_box from the realisation difference; 'unchanged' if < tau; else 'weak'
evaluation.error_decomposition: (1) RNA_T1 vs reference: present in original RNA; (2) A_full vs RNA_T1: introduced by the owned representation; (3) C_frozen vs A_full: caused by invalidation; (4) B_selective vs A_full: remaining after selective reconstruction

outcome_rules.qualification: RNA_T0 and RNA_T1 held-out view-mean PSNR >= 32.44 dB (worklog-36 native level 33.44 - 1.0); A_full (PU) >= RNA_T1 - 0.5 dB and logL1 <= 1.10 x RNA_T1 (worklog-36 Case-A screening). If A_full fails: Full-Recompute Failure, report the static limitation first
outcome_rules.discriminative_edit: C_frozen display MSE on the physically changed region >= 1.25 x A_full's; otherwise the edit is not discriminative for the model and the selective benefit is inconclusive
outcome_rules.positive: all of: B_selective view-mean PSNR >= A_full - 0.26 dB; changed-region recovery R = (E_frozen - E_sel) / (E_frozen - E_full) >= 0.8 (display MSE); V*-owned error of B_selective <= 1.10 x A_full's; V* parameters bit-identical to SO_T0; every output change vs C_frozen inside the predicted support (D*-owned pixels and D* PU bands)
outcome_rules.negative: B_selective < A_full - 1.0 dB or R < 0.5 (with a credible oracle and full control)
outcome_rules.conditional: otherwise; attribute (capacity, unit support, coordinate stability, composition, frozen-unit radiometric invalidity incl. visibility regime, optimisation)
outcome_rules.degenerate_selectivity: |D*| >= 15 of 17: reconstruction correctness only, no reuse claim
